source.name: Escape must close the suggestion list without erasing what the user typed

journey.title: Dismiss suggestions with Escape while editing a saved city
journey.goal: Escape closes the suggestion list and keeps the city the user typed

functionalJourney.title: Pick a suggested city with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Typing part of a name and clicking a suggestion saves that city

guards.title: ArrowDown and Enter still select a suggestion
guards.goal: Typing Fa, ArrowDown and Enter saves Faro

plan.root_cause: The Escape key handler in the list controller clears the input value, causing the user's typed text to be lost when dismissing suggestions.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the line that sets the input value to empty in the Escape case of the navigate function, while keeping the clear event emission and list closure to preserve existing behavior.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will close the suggestion list without modifying the input value, ensuring that the user's entered text remains available to assistive technologies.
functional_risks: Consumers that rely on the 'clear' event expecting the input to be emptied may observe a mismatch between the event and the actual input value.
Any custom logic that depends on the input being cleared when Escape is pressed would need to be updated.
verification_requirements: After typing a value into the city field and pressing Escape, the suggestion list must close, the input must retain the typed value, and focus must return to the input.
ArrowDown and Enter keys must still correctly select a suggestion when the list is open.
The 'clear' event should still be emitted on Escape press to maintain backward compatibility.
